description: Operator/operator-equivalent only, with server-injected context. Uses one exact live ledger session row id, never an alias or canonical expansion. Default confirm=false previews previous/current label and expected_updated_at token without writes. Confirm with the timezone-aware preview token; stale tokens return conflict without retries or receipts. A successful non-null clear changes only vendor_session_label to NULL and standard updated_at, with one immutable clear receipt atomically committed. Missing/deleted rows return not_found; NULL is already_clear. No conversation content is deleted. Ingest None preserves existing metadata; real non-null ingest can correct or restore a label, including on source repoll. Clearing removes only that row's Codex runtime alias proof; exact stored ids retain runtime_identity_unavailable advisory, and independent proving rows remain valid. History starts with this feature and does not reconstruct older labels. Receipts are permanently retained, with no update/delete verb; restoration uses real ingest, followed by a new preview and optional clear.
embedding_description: Operator-only exact-row session label maintenance. Preview a live ledger id to obtain its updated_at token, then confirm a guarded NULL clear with one atomic immutable receipt. No content deletion or alias expansion. Non-null ingest or source repoll can restore labels; None preserves metadata.
